June (Growth): Quick proposal: micro-blast after webinar + small credit nudges. Test copy frames in launch posts and two routing flows. KPI: increase reg->first_api_call by 18% in 7 days.

Marco (Content): OK. Two social narratives: benchmark-led (latency/cost callouts) vs outcome-led (ship a feature in 30m). We'll A/B both on LinkedIn. Short captions only.

Lena (Analytics): Measurement plan: 7d window. Events: `webinar_reg`,`email_sent`,`credit_redeemed`,`first_api_call`,`demo_cta_click`,`sdr_poked`. Create dashboard tile comparing arms + cost-per-activation.

June (Growth): Variant matrix:
- Arm 1 (control): no credits, baseline onboarding prompts.
- Arm 2 (nudge): 30 starter credits + tailored prompt pack.
- Arm 3 (boost): 100 credits + step-by-step quickstart.
Randomize at RSVP completion.

Tom (Sales Ops): Routing: two flows — standard nurture vs fast-route (immediate SDR ping if `demo_cta_click` or `credit_redeemed`). Add `mkt_arm` to HubSpot.

Marco (Content): Post-reg email snippets (ultra short):
- control: "You're in — try our quickstarts."
- nudge: "Claim 30 credits + templates to get started."
- boost: "100 credits + step-by-step guide to build in 30m."
I'll drop creative in #marketing-assets by EOD.

Lena (Analytics): Can we tag UTM params per social creative and add `exp_arm` to event payload? Also want a compare-to-benchmark slide showing last webinar baseline.

June (Growth): yes to UTMs and `exp_arm`. experiment-bot: create exp_1876549999_microblast_credit_routing — sampling 50/30/20, dry-run Mon 09:00 PT.

experiment-bot: tracking updated: added events [`credit_redeemed`,`exp_arm`]. Link: https://amplitude.company/schemas/1876549999

Tom (Sales Ops): I'll add HubSpot mapping + SDR ping template: "Webinar reg — redeemed: <tier> — demo intent: <yes/no>".

Lena (Analytics): Timeline: tracking signoff Fri, creative Wed, dashboard Mon, full launch Tue. Owners: Marco = copy, Tom = routing + HubSpot, Lena = dashboard.

June (Growth): Sync Fri 11am for tracking signoff. Keep the RSVP->API path as frictionless as possible — flag duplicates here. :pray:
